du_an.mo_ta: Mở file De08_P1_Energy.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới (đề tiếng Anh như thi thật).

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: At the end of the document title, insert a heart symbol. Use the Webdings font and character code “89”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ cuối tiêu đề.  2) Insert > Symbol > More Symbols > Font: Webdings; Character code: 89 > Insert > Close.

cham.de_bai: At the end of the document title, insert a heart symbol. Use the Webdings font and character code “89”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Partners” section, set the spacing between the cells of the table to 0.05" (0.13 cm).
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ trong bảng > Table Layout > Cell Margins.  2) Tích Allow spacing between cells: 0.05" > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the “Partners” section, set the spacing between the cells of the table to 0.05" (0.13 cm).

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Future Plans” section, resize the picture to a height of 3" (7.62 cm). Maintain the original aspect ratio.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn ảnh.  2) Picture Format > Size: Shape Height = 3" (Lock aspect ratio đang bật nên chiều còn lại tự đổi).

cham.de_bai: In the “Future Plans” section, resize the picture to a height of 3" (7.62 cm). Maintain the original aspect ratio.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Change the direction of the SmartArt graphic in the “Electric Vehicles” section so that it flows from right to left.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn SmartArt.  2) SmartArt Design > Right to Left.

cham.de_bai: Change the direction of the SmartArt graphic in the “Electric Vehicles” section so that it flows from right to left.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Solar Projects” section, highlight the sentence “We installed solar panels on more than two hundred factory roofs last year.” in Bright Green.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn câu văn.  2) Home > Text Highlight Color > Bright Green.

cham.de_bai: In the “Solar Projects” section, highlight the sentence “We installed solar panels on more than two hundred factory roofs last year.” in Bright Green.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Electric Vehicles” section, apply the Soft Round Bevel shape effect to the SmartArt graphic (be sure to select the entire SmartArt graphic).
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Bấm vào viền ngoài SmartArt, sau đó Ctrl+A để chọn tất cả các hình bên trong.  2) Format > Shape Effects > Bevel > Soft Round.

cham.de_bai: In the “Electric Vehicles” section, apply the Soft Round Bevel shape effect to the SmartArt graphic (be sure to select the entire SmartArt graphic).

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file De08_P2_Festival.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới (đề tiếng Anh như thi thật).

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the file properties, add “Hoi” as a category.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) File > Info > Properties > Show All Properties (hoặc Advanced Properties > Summary).  2) Ô Categories: nhập "Hoi". Nhấn ra ngoài/OK để lưu.

cham.de_bai: In the file properties, add “Hoi” as a category.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Convert the document title to WordArt by using the Fill: Blue, Accent color 1; Shadow style.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn tiêu đề tài liệu.  2) Insert > WordArt > Fill: Blue, Accent color 1; Shadow.

cham.de_bai: Convert the document title to WordArt by using the Fill: Blue, Accent color 1; Shadow style.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Food Stalls” section, insert a new column to the right of the “Location” column of the table. Type “Status” in the first cell of the new column.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ trong cột "Location".  2) Table Layout > Insert Right.  3) Gõ "Status" vào ô đầu tiên của cột mới.

cham.de_bai: In the “Food Stalls” section, insert a new column to the right of the “Location” column of the table. Type “Status” in the first cell of the new column.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Format the heading “Getting There” so that it always appears on the same page as the paragraph that follows it and all lines of the heading are kept together.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ trong tiêu đề.  2) Home > Paragraph dialog > tab Line and Page Breaks.  3) Tích Keep with next và Keep lines together > OK.

cham.de_bai: Format the heading “Getting There” so that it always appears on the same page as the paragraph that follows it and all lines of the heading are kept together.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Food Stalls” section, change the chart title from “Chart Title” to “Participants Overview”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Bấm vào tiêu đề "Chart Title" của biểu đồ.  2) Chọn hết chữ trong tiêu đề và gõ: Participants Overview.

cham.de_bai: In the “Food Stalls” section, change the chart title from “Chart Title” to “Participants Overview”.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file De08_P3_Library.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới (đề tiếng Anh như thi thật).

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Inspect the document and remove all Document Properties and Personal Information. Do not remove any other information.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) File > Info > Check for Issues > Inspect Document (chọn Yes nếu được hỏi lưu).  2) Bấm Inspect.  3) Tại dòng Document Properties and Personal Information bấm Remove All.  4) Không bấm Remove All ở các mục khác. Close.

cham.de_bai: Inspect the document and remove all Document Properties and Personal Information. Do not remove any other information.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Display the Banded footer on all pages of the document.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Insert > Footer > Banded.  2) Đảm bảo Different First Page KHÔNG được tích. Close Header and Footer.

cham.de_bai: Display the Banded footer on all pages of the document.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Check the document for accessibility issues. Correct the table-related issue reported in the inspection result by using the first recommended action.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Review > Check Accessibility.  2) Trong ngăn Accessibility, mở mục lỗi liên quan đến bảng (Missing table header / No header row).  3) Bấm mũi tên cạnh tên bảng > chọn hành động đầu tiên trong Recommended Actions (Use First Row as Header).

cham.de_bai: Check the document for accessibility issues. Correct the table-related issue reported in the inspection result by using the first recommended action.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Apply the Black & White (Classic) style set to the document.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: Design > nhóm Document Formatting > mở gallery Style Set > chọn Black & White (Classic).

cham.de_bai: Apply the Black & White (Classic) style set to the document.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Digital Resources” section, change the numbered list so that it starts at 5.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Nhấp phải vào mục đầu tiên của danh sách > Set Numbering Value.  2) Start new list; Set value to: 5 > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the “Digital Resources” section, change the numbered list so that it starts at 5.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file De08_P4_Social.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới (đề tiếng Anh như thi thật).

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “What Is Social Media?” section, delete the comment that is attached to the text “online platforms”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Bấm vào comment đó.  2) Review > Delete (hoặc … > Delete thread).

cham.de_bai: In the “What Is Social Media?” section, delete the comment that is attached to the text “online platforms”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Change the number format of all footnotes in the document to i, ii, iii, ….
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) References > hộp thoại Footnote and Endnote (mũi tên nhỏ).  2) Footnotes; Number format: i, ii, iii, …; Apply changes to: Whole document > Apply.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Common Mistakes” section, change the list level for “Answer customer questions” to Level 3.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ vào mục "Answer customer questions".  2) Home > mũi tên Bullets/Numbering > Change List Level > Level 3.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Common Mistakes” section, indent both paragraphs after the heading 0.75" (1.91 cm) from the left margin.

cham.de_bai: In the “Spa and Wellness” section, format the 5 paragraphs starting with “Snorkeling” as a numbered list that uses the a) number format.

nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn toàn bộ danh sách bullet.  2) Home > mũi tên Bullets > Define New Bullet > Symbol.  3) Font: Wingdings 2; Character code: 245 > OK > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the “Welcome to Pearl Bay” section, change the bullet points to custom ones. Use the diamond symbol from the Wingdings 2 font and character code “245”.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file De08_P6_Coffee.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới (đề tiếng Anh như thi thật).

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Delete all comments in the document.

cham.de_bai: Delete all comments in the document.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Insert page numbers by using the Bottom of Page Accent Bar 2 style.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: Insert > Page Number > Bottom of Page > Accent Bar 2.

cham.de_bai: Insert page numbers by using the Bottom of Page Accent Bar 2 style.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file De08_P7_Travel_Expert.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới (đề tiếng Anh như thi thật).

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Create a new paragraph style named “Info Box” that uses the Century Gothic font, 12 pt, italic, with 12 pt of spacing after the paragraph. Apply the style to the paragraph that starts with “For more information, email the Mekong …”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ trong đoạn cần áp dụng.  2) Home > Styles pane (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S) > New Style.  3) Name: Info Box; Style type: Paragraph; Font: Century Gothic, 12, Italic.  4) Format > Paragraph > Spacing After: 12 pt > OK > OK (style được áp dụng vào đoạn hiện tại).

cham.de_bai: Create a new paragraph style named “Info Box” that uses the Century Gothic font, 12 pt, italic, with 12 pt of spacing after the paragraph. Apply the style to the paragraph that starts with “For more information, email the Mekong …”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Schedule” section, turn off widow/orphan control for the two paragraphs after the heading and keep the lines of each paragraph together.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn hai đoạn.  2) Home > Paragraph dialog > Line and Page Breaks: bỏ Widow/Orphan control; tích Keep lines together > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the “Schedule” section, turn off widow/orphan control for the two paragraphs after the heading and keep the lines of each paragraph together.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Modify the Heading 1 style so that it uses 18 pt, bold, Dark Blue, Text 2 font color. Apply the changes to this document only.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Home > Styles > nhấp phải Heading 1 > Modify.  2) Size: 18; Bold; Color: Dark Blue, Text 2.  3) Chọn Only in this document > OK.

cham.de_bai: Modify the Heading 1 style so that it uses 18 pt, bold, Dark Blue, Text 2 font color. Apply the changes to this document only.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the blank paragraph at the end of the document, insert the SaveDate field. Use the date format that displays the date as dd/MM/yyyy.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ vào đoạn trống cuối tài liệu.  2) Insert > Quick Parts > Field > Field names: SaveDate.  3) Date formats: nhập dd/MM/yyyy > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the blank paragraph at the end of the document, insert the SaveDate field. Use the date format that displays the date as dd/MM/yyyy.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Link the text box in the “Mission” section to the empty text box in the “Conference Topics” section so that the overflow text flows into the second text box.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn text box thứ nhất.  2) Shape Format > Create Link (con trỏ đổi thành bình).  3) Bấm vào text box trống thứ hai.

cham.de_bai: Link the text box in the “Mission” section to the empty text box in the “Conference Topics” section so that the overflow text flows into the second text box.
